description: Build a bringmethat.com checkout link for the customer's items. Opening checkout_url fills their cart and opens bringmethat.com checkout, where they review the total and pay. Does not charge a card and does not place the order. Validates items and required options first and returns prices, or the problems to fix with the customer. Checkout is the item total plus a 10% markup, the restaurant's own service fee (none for partner restaurants; there is no flat service fee), tax, a $7 delivery fee ($0 for pickup) unless a Habitat or MealMe delivery quote replaces it, and an optional tip. Premium ($9.95/month or $96/year) waives the markup and the service fee, but not delivery, tax, or tip. The card is authorized for that total plus $15 when the total is over $30, otherwise plus 45%. Only the final amount is charged.

delivery_address.description: Street address for delivery, e.g. '2415 N Ashland Ave, Chicago, IL 60614'. Prefills checkout.

options.description: Choices for the item's option groups. Use group_index and option names exactly as get_menu lists them. Required groups must be filled.
